run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable and print average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_with_iterations: test time_func with custom iterations to measure performance of a target function
review_time_func_warmup: review time_func warmup logic that runs 5 preliminary calls before timing
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which uses perf_counter to measure and report function execution time
refactor_time_func_output: refactor time_func to return timing results instead of printing them directly
